verdict: definition viable after explicit W bottom product, post-pack and pre-EOS capture corrections
findings: Define C as actual selected fixed geometry/coefficient inputs and exact real target Y=Q(B+aK), so B+aK formation is included relative to rounded native path; formation upstream of C is excluded explicitly. Recompute the full WRFParity continuity from Y; do not freeze native Mdot.

Implicit mode starts coupled rw_tend at zero after unconditional reset. Supported pressure branch adds interior/top PGF+buoyancy and masks bottom; simplified buoyancy is alternative if base-state fields absent, so require actual base branch. W damping and do_explicit slow terms disabled by effective conditions.

Bottom mask precedes final canonical product-rate subtraction on all W levels. Q projects horizontal aliases and horizontal normal velocity walls but does not by itself force vertical w(k=0)=0. Therefore include -w*rate_w at bottom unless actual W zero is separately established; prior pressure-only bottom-zero result is narrower.

Actual implicit_divergence=true and kdamp=0.2 trigger post-pack applyDivergenceDamping; that source recomputes U/V damping and repacks rw unchanged. Prove source/branch and unchanged W, not assume no postpack operator. Rayleigh is do_explicit gated.

check_tend can replace entire nonfinite W when nan_sanitize_mode=1; require finite branch/guard evidence. Enclose no-floor conditions if modeling the raw mathematical path; factor EOS/projected endpoint calculations through correct exact vs rounded definitions.

Mass-flux memo is evaluated before EOS capture. Existing capture_eos creates fresh PressureEosContext and assigns c=move(snapshot), which would erase any added pre-EOS mass-flux capture unless explicitly preserved. Also ensure last-trial capture and same K/R association.
inputs_and_guards: Retain full B,K0,K1, native R0/R1 and S_inv, actual theta_base and all active geometry/constants with metadata/hashes; actual RDNW before reciprocal, RD, c1/c2, pbase,mub, msf and chosen float rdx/rdy. Gate zero qv/cqw, parity true, single tile canonical wall/periodic and no HEVI, no W damping and no slow transport.
Native output handling, all active terms, source-ordered rounding, and norm/reduction errors require explicit enclosure; exact MPFR target calculation alone does not bound native-vs-target error.
scope: selected endpoints fixed context; no actual run/model/test/source modification
